description.blurb: S/2006 S 15 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Norse group. It was discovered in 2006 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2006 S 15 is about 4 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 21.8 million km in 1213.96 days. It has an inclination of 161.1° to the ecliptic in a retrograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.117.
